title.zh: 卷十一 本紀第十一 仁宗三
title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一 仁宗三 Volume 11 Annals 11: Renzong 3

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年春正月辛亥朔，禦大慶殿受朝。

translations.literal: Qingli year one, spring, first month, day xinhai new moon: the emperor held court in Daqing Hall to receive homage.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 1, new moon xinhai: he received court in Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 己未，加唃廝囉河西節度使。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Gusiluo was made military commissioner of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Gusiluo received Hexi command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔歲以春分祠高禖。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: each year at the spring equinox the High Matron was to be sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, annual spring-equinox rites to the High Matron were ordered.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊請和。

translations.literal: That month: Yuanhao sought peace.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao asked for peace.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，壽國公昕薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day jihai: Duke of Shouguo Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jihai: Duke of Shouguo Xin died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，罷大宴。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the great feast was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the grand banquet was canceled.

sentences.zh: 京東西、淮、浙、江南、荊湖置宣毅軍。

translations.literal: Xuanyi armies were established in eastern and western Jing, Huai, Zhe, Jiangnan, and Jinghu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyi corps were raised across the east, Huai, Zhe, Jiangnan, and Jinghu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔臣僚受外任者，毋得因臨遣祈恩。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: officials receiving outer appointments were not to use farewell audiences to seek favor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, outgoing officials were forbidden to trade farewell audiences for favors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，京師雨藥。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: medicine rained on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, medicine fell from the sky over the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇渭州，環慶路馬步軍副總管任福敗于好水川，福及將佐軍士死者六千余人。

translations.literal: That month: Yuanhao raided Wei prefecture; Ren Fu, deputy overall commander of Huanqing circuit horse and foot, was defeated at Haoshui Creek—Fu and officers and soldiers, more than six thousand, died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao hit Weizhou; at Haoshui Creek Huanqing’s Ren Fu was destroyed—over six thousand dead, Fu among them.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌朔，修金堤。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu new moon: the golden dike was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon gengxu: the golden dike was repaired.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔止郡國舉人，勿以邊機為名希求恩澤。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: halt recommending examination candidates under the name of frontier emergencies to seek favor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, exam nominees could no longer cite border crises for favors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，以資政殿學士陳執中同陝西馬步軍都總管兼經略安撫沿邊招討等使、知永興軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: Academician Chen Zhizhong was made overall commander of Shaanxi horse and foot, frontier commissioner and pacifier, along-border recruiter, and prefect of Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiashen: Chen Zhizhong took Shaanxi command, frontier pacification, and Yongxing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔夏竦仍判永興軍。

translations.literal: Edict: Xia Song remained acting at Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Song stayed acting at Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，下德音：降陝西囚死罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: a lenient edict reduced Shaanxi capital crimes one degree; exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shaanxi won one-grade relief and release below exile.

sentences.zh: 特支軍士緡錢，振撫邊民被鈔略者親屬。

translations.literal: Special cash was issued to the troops; kin of border people raided by enemy scouts were comforted.
translations.idiomatic: Troops received special pay; families of border raid victims were aided.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，出內藏緡錢一百萬助軍費。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: one million strings from the inner treasury were released for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a million strings from the inner treasury went to the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，追封皇長子為褒王，賜名昉。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the eldest imperial son was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Bao and given the name Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the eldest son was posthumously Prince of Bao, named Fang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷陝西經略安撫沿邊招討都監。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Shaanxi frontier commissioner and along-border recruiter inspector were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Shaanxi frontier recruiter post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋庠、鄭戩罷，以王舉正參知政事，任中師、任布為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Song Qiu and Zheng Yan were removed; Wang Juzheng became participating administrator; Ren Zhongshi and Ren Bu vice military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Song Qiu and Zheng Yan fell; Wang Juzheng joined the council; Ren Zhongshi and Ren Bu took military posts.

sentences.zh: 詔夏竦屯軍鄜州，陳執中屯軍涇州。

translations.literal: Edict: Xia Song was to station troops at Bin prefecture; Chen Zhizhong at Jing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Song was posted to Binzhou; Chen Zhizhong to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，閱試衛士。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: guards were reviewed in drill.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, palace guards were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，詔陝西諸路總管司嚴邊備，毋輒入賊界，賊至則禦之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen, edict: Shaanxi circuit overall headquarters were to tighten defenses, not rashly enter enemy territory; when the enemy came, resist.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: Shaanxi commands were ordered to defend, not raid—and fight when attacked.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔近臣舉河北、陝西、河東知州、通判、縣令。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: close officials were to recommend prefects, magistrates, and county chiefs of Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, intimates were to nominate Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，月掩心後星。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: the moon occulted the star after Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingchen: the moon covered the star after Heart.

sentences.zh: 戊午，月掩南斗。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the moon occulted the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the moon covered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，置萬勝軍凡二十指揮。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the Ten Thousand Victories army was established—twenty commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Ten Thousand Victories army was formed—twenty commands.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇麟、府州。

translations.literal: That month: Yuanhao raided Lin and Fu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao struck Lin and Fu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，詔鄜延部署以兵援麟、府。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin, edict: the Bin-Yan commissioner was to send troops to relieve Lin and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: Bin-Yan forces were ordered to relieve Lin and Fu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，河北置場括市戰馬，緣邊七州軍免括。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Hebei set up markets to buy war horses; seven frontier prefectures and armies were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Hebei began buying horses; seven border commands were exempt.

sentences.zh: 乙未，毀潼關新置樓櫓。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: newly built towers at Tong Pass were torn down.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Tong Pass’s new towers were demolished.

sentences.zh: 庚子，月掩歲星。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the moon occulted Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the moon covered Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，募民間材勇者補神捷指揮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the brave among the people were recruited to fill the Divine Swift command.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, bold civilians were drafted into the Divine Swift command.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇金明砦，破寧遠砦，砦主王世亶、兵馬監押王顯死之。

translations.literal: That month: Yuanhao raided Jinming fort, stormed Ningyuan fort; fort chief Wang Shichang and horse inspector Wang Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao took Jinming and Ningyuan; Wang Shichang and Wang Xian died defending them.

sentences.zh: 陷豐州，知州王余慶、兵馬監押孫吉死之。

translations.literal: Feng prefecture fell; prefect Wang Yuqing and horse inspector Sun Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou fell; Wang Yuqing and Sun Ji were killed.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，命河東鑄大鐵錢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: Hedong was ordered to cast great iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renzi: Hedong was ordered to cast large iron coins.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復置義倉。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the charity granary was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, charity granaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，詔罷陝西都部署，分四路置使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu, edict: the Shaanxi overall commissioner was abolished; four circuit commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiawu: Shaanxi’s single commander was split into four circuit commissioners.

sentences.zh: 置陝西營田務。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi military colony office was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Shaanxi military colony office was opened.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷銅符、木契。

translations.literal: Day jihai: bronze tallies and wooden contracts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, bronze tallies and wooden contracts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 是月，修河北城池。

translations.literal: That month: Hebei city walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hebei walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，置涇原路強壯弓箭手。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi: strong bowmen of Jingyuan circuit were established.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renzi: Jingyuan strong bowmen were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，發廩粟，減價以濟京城民。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: granary grain was released at reduced price to aid capital citizens.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, state grain was sold cheap to capital paupers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: morning feast at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, morning rites at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，饗太廟、奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day yichou: feast at the imperial temple and Offering Grace temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, offerings at the ancestral and Offering Grace temples.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，祀天地於圜丘，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; great amnesty; era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, suburban rites brought amnesty and a new reign title.

sentences.zh: 蠲陝西來年夏稅十之二，及麟、府民二年賦租。

translations.literal: A tenth of next year’s summer tax in Shaanxi was remitted, and two years’ rent for Lin and Fu people.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi’s next summer tax was cut a tenth; Lin and Fu got two years’ rent relief.

sentences.zh: 臣僚許立家廟。

translations.literal: Officials were permitted to establish family temples.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were allowed family temples.

sentences.zh: 功臣不限品數賜戟。

translations.literal: Meritorious officials were given halberds without rank limit.
translations.idiomatic: Merit holders of any rank could receive ceremonial halberds.

sentences.zh: 增天下解額。

translations.literal: Examination quotas empire-wide were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Civil exam quotas were raised across the empire.

sentences.zh: 弛京東八州鹽禁。

translations.literal: The salt ban in eight Jingdong prefectures was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Salt restrictions eased in eight Jingdong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是月，令江、饒、池三州鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: That month: Jiang, Rao, and Chi prefectures were ordered to cast iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiang, Rao, and Chi began casting iron coins.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: officials received added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingzi: officials received extra favors.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，司天監上《崇天萬年曆》。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Directorate of Astronomy presented the Chongtian Ten-Thousand-Years calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, astronomers submitted the Chongtian Ten-Thousand-Years calendar.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔陝西四路總管及轉運使兼營田。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: Shaanxi four-circuit commanders and transport commissioners were concurrently to run military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Shaanxi commanders and transport chiefs took over military colonies.

sentences.zh: 甲午，置陝西護塞軍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Shaanxi frontier-guard army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Shaanxi frontier-guard army was formed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，湖南洞蠻知徽州楊通漢貢方物。

translations.literal: That year: cave chieftain Yang Tonghan of Huai prefecture in southern Hunan presented local goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huai’s cave chief Yang Tonghan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，復京師榷鹽法。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day dingsi: the capital salt monopoly was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, dingsi: capital salt monopoly was restored.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以京西閒田處內附蕃族無親屬者。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: idle fields in western Jing were to house inward-submitting Fan without kin.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, western Jing idle land was set aside for kinless Fan defectors.

sentences.zh: 遣使河北募兵，及萬人者賞之。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to Hebei to recruit troops; those reaching ten thousand were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei recruiters were rewarded for levies of ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔磨勘院考提點刑獄功罪為三等，以待黜陟。

translations.literal: Day guihai, edict: the scrutiny court was to grade punishment intendants’ merit and fault in three grades for promotion or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, punishment intendants were to be graded in three tiers for promotion or removal.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，詔河北強壯刺手背為義勇軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei, edict: strong Hebei men were to tattoo the back as Righteous Courage army.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiwei: Hebei stalwarts were tattooed into the Righteous Courage army.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰朔，詔殿前指揮使、兩省都知舉武臣才堪為將者。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen new moon, edict: the palace army commander and both provincial palace controllers were to recommend military men fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon jiachen: palace and provincial chiefs were to nominate officers fit for command.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，杜衍宣撫河東。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Du Yan was made pacification commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Du Yan pacified Hedong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，晁宗愨罷。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Chao Zongyi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chao Zongyi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，契丹遣蕭英、劉六符來致書求割地。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Khitan sent Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu with a letter demanding ceded territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Khitan envoys Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu demanded land.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身八百三十九人。

translations.literal: That month: 839 men who passed the Ministry of Rites examination and various autumn cohorts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, 839 examination graduates received honors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，命御史中丞、諫官同較三司用度，罷其不急者。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin: the censor-in-chief and remonstrators were ordered jointly to compare three-department spending and abolish what was not urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuyin: censors and remonstrators were to cut non-urgent three-department spending.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，知制誥富弼報使契丹。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: drafting academician Fu Bi was envoy to reply to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Fu Bi went to answer the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinhai: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，減皇后及宗室婦郊賜之半。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the empress’s and imperial clan women’s suburban gifts were halved.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, suburban gifts to the empress and clan women were cut in half.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔三館臣僚上封事及聽請對。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: Hanlin and archive officials were to submit sealed memorials and request audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, archive scholars could submit sealed memorials and seek audience.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔醫官毋得換右職。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: medical officers were not to exchange into right-flank posts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, medical officers could not transfer to right-flank posts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，建大名府為北京。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Daming prefecture was made the northern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Daming became the northern capital.

sentences.zh: 降河北州軍系囚罪一等，杖、笞以下釋之。

translations.literal: Hebei prefectures and armies: crimes reduced one degree; beating and flogging released.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei won one-grade relief; flogging cases freed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷左藏庫月進錢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the left treasury’s monthly tribute money was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the left treasury’s monthly tribute was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禁銷金為服飾。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: gilded clothing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, gilded dress was banned.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹集兵幽州，聲言來侵，河北、京東皆為邊備。

translations.literal: That month: the Khitan massed troops at Youzhou, proclaiming invasion; Hebei and Jingdong both prepared defenses.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan gathered at Youzhou threatening invasion; Hebei and Jingdong mobilized.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，出內藏銀、紬、絹三百萬助邊費。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: three million in silver, silk, and cloth from the inner treasury aided frontier costs.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu: three million in inner-treasury silver and silk went to the border.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以特奏名武藝人補三班。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: men of special martial entry were enrolled in the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, specially entered martialists joined the third rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置北平軍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Northern Peace army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Northern Peace army was formed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，閱蕃落將士騎射。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Fan tribal officers and soldiers were reviewed in mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Fan officers rehearsed mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔減省南郊臣僚賜與。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: southern suburb gifts to officials were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, southern suburb gifts to officials were cut.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，任布罷。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingwu: Ren Bu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingwu: Ren Bu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔軍校戰沒無子孫者，賜其家緡錢。

translations.literal: Day dingwei, edict: where military officers died in battle without descendants, their families were given cash.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, childless fallen officers’ families received cash.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, violent hailstorms struck.

sentences.zh: 以呂夷簡兼判樞密院事，章得象兼樞密使，晏殊加平章事。

translations.literal: Lü Yijian was made concurrent military affairs commissioner; Zhang Dexiang concurrent military affairs commissioner; Yan Shu was made grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yijian took military affairs; Zhang Dexiang joined him; Yan Shu became grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，富弼再使契丹。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Fu Bi was again envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Fu Bi returned to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔京官告病者，一年方聽朝參。

translations.literal: Edict: capital officials reporting illness had to wait one year before attending court.
translations.idiomatic: Sick capital officials could not return to court for a year.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，策制舉人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: special-entry candidates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingchou: special-entry scholars were tested.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，策武舉人試騎射。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: military candidates were tested in mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, military candidates shot from horseback.

sentences.zh: 甲申，白氣貫北斗。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: white vapor pierced the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, white mist ran through the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 戊子，出內藏庫緡錢十萬修北京行宮。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: one hundred thousand strings from the inner treasury repaired the northern capital traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, a hundred thousand strings repaired the northern capital palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣使安撫京東，督捕盜賊。

translations.literal: Day jihai: envoys were sent to comfort Jingdong and supervise bandit capture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, envoys pacified Jingdong and hunted bandits.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，呂夷簡改兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: Lü Yijian was changed to concurrent military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingwu: Lü Yijian’s military post was regularized.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，契丹遣耶律仁先、劉六符持誓書來。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Khitan sent Yelü Renxian and Liu Liufu with the oath document.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Khitan envoys brought the oath.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，罷河北民間科徭。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day wuxu: Hebei folk corvées were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wuxu: Hebei labor levies were lifted.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇定川砦，涇原路馬步軍副都總管葛懷敏戰沒，諸將死者十四人，元昊大掠渭州而去。

translations.literal: That month: Yuanhao raided Dingchuan fort; Ge Huaimin, deputy overall commander of Jingyuan horse and foot, died in battle; fourteen generals died; Yuanhao plundered Wei prefecture and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao hit Dingchuan; Jingyuan’s Ge Huaimin and fourteen generals fell; Wei was looted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，刺陝西保捷軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: Shaanxi Secure Victory army was tattooed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengxu: Shaanxi Secure Victory troops were tattooed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使安撫涇原路。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: envoys were sent to pacify Jingyuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, envoys were dispatched to calm Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，知制誥梁適報使契丹。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: drafting academician Liang Shi returned from reporting to Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Liang Shi came back from his Khitan mission.

sentences.zh: 戊午，發定州禁軍二萬二千人屯涇原。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: twenty-two thousand Dingzhou palace troops were sent to garrison Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, twenty-two thousand Dingzhou guards marched to Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔恤將校陣亡，其妻女無依者養之宮中。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: officers and men killed in battle were to be comforted; wives and daughters without support were to be raised in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the fallen were honored—and widows and orphans without kin were taken into the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，契丹遣使來再致誓書，報徹兵。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Khitan sent envoys again with sworn letters, reporting withdrawal of troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Khitan envoys brought new oaths and word that their armies had pulled back.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，黑氣貫北斗柄。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen: black vapor pierced the handle of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renshen: black mist ran through the Dipper’s handle.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復都部署兼招討等使，命韓琦、范仲淹、龐籍分領之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the overall deployment with frontier pacification commissioner was restored; Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, and Pang Ji were ordered to command separately.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, frontier command was restored; Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, and Pang Ji each took a theater.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以泰山處士孫復為國子監直講。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Mount Tai recluse Sun Fu was made direct lecturer of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Sun Fu of Mount Tai became lecturer at the imperial college.

sentences.zh: 是歲，占城獻馴象三。

translations.literal: That year, Champa presented three tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent three trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚午朔，封皇子曦為鄂王。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day gengwu new moon: Prince Xi was enfeoffed as Prince of E.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, new moon gengwu: Prince Xi became Prince of E.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曦薨。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Prince Xi died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，減陝西歲市木三之一。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Shaanxi’s annual timber purchases were cut by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Shaanxi timber levies fell by a third.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔輔臣議蠲減天下賦役。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, edict: chief ministers were to discuss reducing taxes and corvée throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the cabinet was ordered to plan tax and corvée relief empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔錄將校死王事而無子孫者親屬。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: kin of officers who died in royal service without descendants were to be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, families of childless officers who died for the throne were registered for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置德順軍。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Deshun army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Deshun army was formed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，錄唐狄仁傑後。

translations.literal: Day renchen: descendants of Tang’s Di Renjie were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, heirs of Tang’s Di Renjie were recorded.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，元昊自名曩霄，遣人來納款，稱夏國。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Yuanhao styled himself Nangxiao, sent men to submit, and called his state Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yuanhao took the name Nangxiao, sued for peace, and styled his realm Xia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，賜陝西招討韓琦、范仲淹、龐籍錢各百萬。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingwu: Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, and Pang Ji on Shaanxi pacification were each given a million strings.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingwu: Han Qi, Fan Zhongyan, and Pang Ji each received a million strings for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，立四門學。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Four Gates school was founded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Four Gates school opened.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，閱衛士武技。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: palace guards’ martial skills were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renshen: palace guards were tested in arms.

sentences.zh: 戊子，呂夷簡罷為司徒、監修國史，與議軍國大事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Lü Yijian was removed to grand mentor and overseer of national history, with voice in great affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Lü Yijian stepped down to grand mentor and historiographer but kept a seat on great affairs.

sentences.zh: 以章得象為昭文館大學士，晏殊為集賢殿大學士並兼樞密使，夏竦為樞密使，賈昌朝參知政事。

translations.literal: Zhang Dexiang was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Yan Shu grand academician of the Jixian Hall and also military affairs commissioner; Xia Song military affairs commissioner; Jia Changchao participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dexiang took Zhaowen; Yan Shu took Jixian and the Military Commission; Xia Song joined it; Jia Changchao entered the council.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，幸瓊林苑閱騎士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu new moon: the emperor visited Qionlin Garden to review horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon wuxu: he reviewed cavalry at Qionlin Garden.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣保安軍判官邵良佐使元昊，許封冊為夏國主，歲賜絹十萬匹、茶三萬斤。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Bao’an army judge Shao Liangzuo was sent to Yuanhao; enfeoffment as Xia king was granted, with annual gifts of one hundred thousand bolts of silk and thirty thousand jin of tea.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Shao Liangzuo went to Yuanhao with an offer of kingship—one hundred thousand bolts of silk and thirty thousand jin of tea each year.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以韓琦、范仲淹為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan were made vice military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan became vice commissioners of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔夏竦還本鎮，以杜衍為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: Xia Song returned to his original command; Du Yan was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Xia Song went back to his post; Du Yan took the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以春夏不雨，遣使祠禱于嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: because spring and summer had not rained, envoys were sent to pray at mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, drought sent envoys to pray at the sacred peaks and streams.

sentences.zh: 甲子，呂夷簡罷議軍國大事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lü Yijian ceased deliberating on great affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lü Yijian left deliberations on great affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon dingmao: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔諸路轉運使並兼按察使，歲具官吏能否以聞。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: circuit transport commissioners were also to serve as surveillance commissioners and yearly report officials’ competence.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, transport commissioners doubled as inspectors and had to report yearly on every official’s fitness.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，祈雨于相國寺、會靈觀。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: rain was prayed for at Xiangguo Monastery and Huiling Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, rain was sought at Xiangguo Monastery and Huiling Abbey.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置御史六員，罷推直官。

translations.literal: Day guimao: six censors were added; push-through investigators were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, six censors were added and push-through investigators abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，置武學。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Military Academy was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Military Academy opened.

sentences.zh: 戊子，雨。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己丑，謝雨。

translations.literal: Day jichou: thanks were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the court thanked Heaven for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，築欽天壇於禁中。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Observing Heaven altar was built within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Observing Heaven altar rose inside the palace walls.

sentences.zh: 乙未，近臣薦試方略者六人，授官有差。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: six men recommended by close officials for strategy examination received offices by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, six strategists tested on court recommendation were appointed at graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 是月，忻州地大震。

translations.literal: That month, Xin prefecture suffered a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xinzhou was shaken by a great earthquake.

sentences.zh: 虎翼卒王倫叛於沂州。

translations.literal: Tiger-Wing soldier Wang Lun rebelled at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lun of the Tiger-Wing corps rebelled at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，詔諸路漕臣令所部官吏條茶、鹽、礬及坑冶利害以聞。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen, edict: circuit transport chiefs were to have subordinate officials list the gains and losses of tea, salt, alum, and mining.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: transport chiefs were ordered to survey tea, salt, alum, and mines in their circuits.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，詔許二府不限奏事常制，得敷陳留對。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinwei, edict: the two bureaus might exceed regular memorial limits and present matters at length in audience.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinwei: both bureaus could break memorial routine and speak at length before the throne.

sentences.zh: 丙子，王舉正罷。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Wang Juzheng was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Wang Juzheng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷陝西管內營田。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Shaanxi interior garrison farms were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Shaanxi garrison farms were shut down.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命任中師宣撫河東，范仲淹宣撫陝西。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Ren Zhongshi was ordered to pacify Hedong; Fan Zhongyan to pacify Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Ren Zhongshi pacified Hedong and Fan Zhongyan Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，獲王倫。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wang Lun was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wang Lun was taken.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未朔，命官詳定編敕。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei new moon: officials were ordered to revise the compiled statutes in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon yiwei: officials were told to revise the compiled statutes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔諫官日赴內朝。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, edict: remonstrance officials were to attend inner court daily.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, remonstrance officials were required at inner court every day.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以范仲淹參知政事，富弼為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Fan Zhongyan was made participating administrator; Fu Bi vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Fan Zhongyan joined the council and Fu Bi the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 壬子，白氣貫北斗魁。

translations.literal: Day renzi: white vapor pierced the Dipper’s head.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, white mist ran through the Dipper’s crown.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，韓琦代范仲淹宣撫陝西。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Han Qi replaced Fan Zhongyan in pacifying Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Han Qi took over Shaanxi pacification from Fan Zhongyan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷武學。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Military Academy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Military Academy was closed.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，詔輔臣對天章閣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao, edict: chief ministers were to answer at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingmao: the cabinet was summoned to the Hall of Heavenly Patterns.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，呂夷簡以太尉致仕。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Lü Yijian retired as grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Lü Yijian retired as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，任中師罷。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Ren Zhongshi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Ren Zhongshi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔執政大臣非假休不許私第受謁。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: chief ministers on leave might not receive callers at their private residences.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, chief ministers on leave were forbidden private audiences at home.

sentences.zh: 是月，桂陽洞蠻寇邊，湖南提刑募兵討平之。

translations.literal: That month, Guiyang cave barbarians raided the border; Hunan judicial commissioner raised troops and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Guiyang tribes raided the border; Hunan’s judicial commissioner raised troops and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，詔中書、樞密同選諸路轉運使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu, edict: the Secretariat and Military Commission were jointly to select circuit transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingwu: the Secretariat and Military Commission jointly picked circuit transport commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔縣令佐能根括編戶隱偽以增賦入者，量其數賞之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei, edict: magistrates and assistants who rooted out hidden households and false registers to increase revenue were to be rewarded in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, magistrates who exposed hidden households and swelled the tax rolls were to be rewarded in proportion.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔二府同選諸路提刑。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: the two bureaus were jointly to select circuit judicial commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, both bureaus jointly selected circuit judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復諸路轉運判官。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: circuit transport vice commissioners were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, circuit transport vice commissioners were restored.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔修兵書。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: military books were to be revised.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the court ordered a revision of military manuals.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔二府頒新定磨勘式。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: the two bureaus were to promulgate the newly fixed merit-review formulary.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, both bureaus issued the new merit-review formulary.

sentences.zh: 甲子，築水洛城。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Shuiluo city was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Shuiluo city was fortified.

sentences.zh: 是月，光化軍亂，討平之。

translations.literal: That month, Guanghua army mutinied and was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Guanghua army mutinied; troops put it down.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，上清宮火。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: Shangqing Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingyin: Shangqing Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔館職有闕，以兩府、兩省保舉，然後召試補用。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: when academy posts were vacant, the two bureaus and the two provinces were to recommend, then candidates were summoned and tested before appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, vacant academy posts were to be filled by nomination from both bureaus and both provinces, then examination.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，更蔭補法。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the yin privilege appointment law was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, hereditary appointment by yin privilege was reformed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，限職田。

translations.literal: Day renchen: official field holdings were limited.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, caps were set on officials’ field allotments.

sentences.zh: 是月，五星皆在東方。

translations.literal: That month, all five planets were in the east.
translations.idiomatic: That month, all five planets stood in the eastern sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，桂陽監徭賊復寇邊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: Guiyang surveillance Yao bandits again raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi: Guiyang Yao raiders struck the border again.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大雨雪，木冰。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: great rain and snow; trees were coated in ice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, heavy snow glazed the trees in ice.

sentences.zh: 河北雨赤雪。

translations.literal: Hebei rained red snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei saw red snow.

sentences.zh: 交阯獻馴象五。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi presented five tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi sent five trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 安化州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: Anhua prefecture barbarians came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Anhua tribes brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚午，京城雪寒，詔三司減價出薪米以濟之。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day gengwu: the capital was cold with snow; the Finance Commission was ordered to sell fuel and grain cheaply to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, first month, gengwu: capital snow and cold sent the Finance Commission to sell cheap fuel and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，西蕃磨氈角入貢。

translations.literal: Day renshen: western tribesman Mozhanjiao came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the western tribesman Mozhanjiao presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，荊王元儼薨。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Prince Jing Yuan Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Prince Jing Yuan Yan died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太常禮儀院上新修《禮書》及《慶曆祀儀》。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Court of Imperial Sacrifices presented the newly revised Rites and the Qingli Sacrificial Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the ritual office submitted the revised Rites and Qingli Sacrificial Rites.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，出奉宸庫銀三萬兩振陝西饑民。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: thirty thousand taels of silver from the Inner Service treasury were issued to relieve Shaanxi famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingshen: thirty thousand taels from the inner treasury fed Shaanxi’s hungry.

sentences.zh: 己酉，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a white rainbow spanned the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷陝西四路馬步軍都總管、經略安撫招討使，復置隨路都總管、經略安撫招討使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Shaanxi’s four-circuit combined cavalry-infantry grand commander and frontier pacification commissioner were abolished; per-circuit grand commanders and pacification commissioners were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Shaanxi’s four-way combined command was split again—each circuit got its own commander and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥朔，以旱遣內侍祈雨。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai new moon: because of drought, inner attendants were sent to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon guihai: drought sent inner attendants to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛未，省廣濟河歲漕軍儲二十萬石。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Guangji Canal’s annual transport of army grain was cut by two hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Guangji Canal grain shipments fell by two hundred thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔天下州縣立學，更定科舉法，語在《選舉志》。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: every prefecture and county was to establish schools and the examination law was revised—details in the Elections monograph.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the empire was ordered to open county schools and reform examinations—see the Elections monograph.

sentences.zh: 己卯，出禦書治道三十五事賜講讀官。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor’s brush on thirty-five matters of governance was issued to lecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, his essay on thirty-five points of rule went to the lecture officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，錄唐郭子儀後。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: descendants of Tang’s Guo Ziyi were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, heirs of Tang’s Guo Ziyi were recorded.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免衡、道州、桂陽監民經徭賊劫略者賦役一年。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: people of Heng, Dao prefectures and Guiyang surveillance who had suffered Yao bandit raids were exempted from taxes and corvée for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Heng, Dao, and Guiyang people plundered by Yao raiders were freed from taxes and corvée for a year.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，詔湖南民誤為征徭軍所殺者，賜帛存撫其家。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingshen, edict: Hunan people mistakenly killed by conscript Yao troops were to receive silk and their families comforted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingshen: Hunan families of civilians killed by mistake in the Yao campaign received silk and consolation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宜州蠻區希範叛，詔廣西轉運鈐轄司發兵討捕。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Yizhou barbarian Qu Xifan rebelled; the Guangxi transport and command office was ordered to raise troops to hunt him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Qu Xifan of Yizhou rebelled; Guangxi was ordered to hunt him down.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以錫慶院為太學。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Xiqing courtyard was made the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Xiqing courtyard became the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengwu: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸國子監謁孔子，有司言舊儀止肅揖，帝特再拜。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the emperor visited the Directorate of Education to salute Confucius; the officials said old rite was only a respectful bow, but the emperor bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, he visited the imperial college to honor Confucius; told the old rite was a single bow, he bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 賜直講孫復五品服。

translations.literal: Direct lecturer Sun Fu was given fifth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer Sun Fu received fifth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 遂幸武成王廟，又幸玉津園觀種稻。

translations.literal: Then he visited the Martial Completion king’s temple, then Jade Ford Garden to view rice planting.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to the Martial Completion temple, then Jade Ford Garden to watch rice planted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，撫州獻生金山。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Fuzhou presented a living golden mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Fuzhou offered a living “golden mountain.”

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔西川知州軍監，罷任未出界而卒者，錄其子孫一人。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: for Xichuan prefecture and army supervisors who died before leaving their jurisdiction after dismissal, one descendant was to be enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Sichuan prefects who died before leaving post after dismissal could register one heir for office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔募人納粟振淮南饑。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: men were recruited to contribute grain to relieve Huainan famine.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the court bought grain from volunteers to feed Huainan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，忻州言地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Xin prefecture reported an earthquake with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xinzhou reported an earthquake that thundered.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，曩霄遣人來，復稱臣。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Nangxiao sent men again, again styling himself subject.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Nangxiao sent envoys again and again called himself the emperor’s subject.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，降天下系囚流、徒罪一等，杖、笞釋之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: prisoners throughout the realm had exile and penal servitude reduced one degree; beating and flogging were released.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renzi: empire-wide, exile and servitude were cut one grade; flogging cases freed.

sentences.zh: 范仲淹宣撫陝西、河東。

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan pacified Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan took up pacification of Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔諸軍因戰傷廢停不能自存及死事之家孤老，月給米，人三斗。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: for armies disabled in battle who could not support themselves and for orphaned elderly in families of the battle-dead, three dou of rice monthly per person.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, disabled veterans and orphaned elderly in fallen soldiers’ families received three dou of rice each month.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，封宗室德文等十人為郡王、國公。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: ten clansmen including Dewen were enfeoffed as commandery princes and state dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuyin: ten kinsmen including Dewen became commandery princes and state dukes.

sentences.zh: 壬午，月犯熒惑。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the moon violated Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the moon crossed Mars.

sentences.zh: 癸未，契丹遣使來告伐夏國。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Khitan sent envoys announcing an attack on the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Khitan envoys announced a campaign against Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夷人寇三江砦，淯井監官兵擊走之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Yi people raided Sanjiang fort; Yujing surveillance troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yi raiders hit Sanjiang fort; Yujing troops beat them back.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔諸路轉運、提刑察舉守令有治狀者。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: circuit transport and judicial commissioners were to recommend prefects and magistrates with good records of rule.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, transport and judicial commissioners were to nominate prefects and magistrates who governed well.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，命賈昌朝領天下農田，范仲淹領刑法事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao: Jia Changchao was put in charge of empire-wide garrison fields; Fan Zhongyan of penal law.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinmao: Jia Changchao took empire-wide garrison fields; Fan Zhongyan, penal law.

sentences.zh: 甲午，富弼宣撫河北。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Fu Bi pacified Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Fu Bi pacified Hebei.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命右正言余靖報使契丹。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: right remonstrance official Yu Jing was ordered to report to Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yu Jing was sent to report to Khitan.

sentences.zh: 保州雲翼軍殺官吏、據城叛。

translations.literal: Baozhou Cloud-Wing army killed officials and seized the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: At Baozhou the Cloud-Wing corps killed their officers and seized the city.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命右正言田況度視保州，仍聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: right remonstrance official Tian Kuang was ordered to inspect Baozhou and act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Tian Kuang was sent to Baozhou with full discretion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，進宗室官有差。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: imperial clansmen’s offices were advanced by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, imperial kinsmen’s ranks were raised.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔輔臣所薦官毋以為諫官、御史。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: officials recommended by chief ministers were not to be made remonstrance officials or censors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, ministers’ nominees could not be made remonstrators or censors.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，以西界內附香布為團練使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: a western tribesman who had submitted within the border was made regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renxu: a western tribesman who had come in from the border was made regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔戒朋黨相訐，及按察恣為苛刻、文人肆言行怪者。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: factional denunciation was forbidden, as were surveillance commissioners’ harshness and literati’s willful strange conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the court forbade factional slander, harsh inspectors, and literati theatrics.

sentences.zh: 己卯，改上莊穆皇后諡曰章穆，莊獻明肅皇太后曰章獻明肅，莊懿皇太后曰章懿，莊懷皇后曰章懷，莊惠皇太后曰章惠。

translations.literal: Day jimao: posthumous styles of empresses were changed—to Bright Solemn for Zhuangmu, Bright Offering Bright Solemn for Zhuangxian, Bright Grace for Zhuangyi, Bright Cherishing for Zhuanghuai, and Bright Kindness for Zhuanghui.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, empresses’ posthumous styles were revised—Zhuangmu to Bright Solemn, Zhuangxian to Bright Offering Bright Solemn, and the rest likewise.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: morning offerings at Jingling Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, morning offerings at Jingling Abbey.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，饗太廟、奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: offerings at the imperial temple and Fengci temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, offerings at the imperial and Fengci temples.

sentences.zh: 壬午，冬至，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day renwu: winter solstice; Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, winter solstice: sacrifice at the round altar and great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: officials received added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen: officials received added favor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，封曩霄為夏國主。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Nangxiao was enfeoffed as Xia king.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Nangxiao was enfeoffed king of Xia.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔州縣以先帝所賜七條相誨敕。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: prefectures and counties were to admonish the people with the late emperor’s seven injunctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, every county was told to teach the late emperor’s seven injunctions.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置保安、鎮戎軍榷場。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: frontier markets were established at Bao’an and Zhenrong armies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, frontier markets opened at Bao’an and Zhenrong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，黎州邛部川山前、山后百蠻都鬼主牟黑來貢。

translations.literal: That year, the hundred barbarian chieftain Mouhei of Qiong tribal prefecture before and behind the mountains in Lizhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Mouhei, chieftain of Lizhou’s Qiong tribes before and behind the mountains, brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲戌，罷河東、陝西諸路招討使。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Hedong and Shaanxi frontier pacification commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, first month, jiaxu: Hedong and Shaanxi pacification commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復置言事御史。

translations.literal: Day yihai: remonstrance censors on policy were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, policy remonstrance censors were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙子，契丹遣使來告伐夏國還。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Khitan sent envoys reporting return from attacking the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Khitan envoys reported their Xia campaign was over.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命知制誥余靖報使契丹。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: drafting academician Yu Jing was ordered to report to Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yu Jing was sent again to Khitan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔京朝官因被彈奏，雖不曾責罰，但有改移差遣，並四周年磨勘。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: capital officials impeached but not punished, if only reassigned, were subject to four-year merit review.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, impeached capital officials who escaped punishment but were reassigned still faced four-year merit review.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，范仲淹、富弼罷。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Fan Zhongyan and Fu Bi were removed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Fan Zhongyan and Fu Bi fell.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，杜衍罷，以賈昌朝同中書門下平章事兼樞密使、集賢殿大學士，王貽永為樞密使，宋庠參知政事，吳育、龐籍並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Du Yan was removed; Jia Changchao was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and military affairs commissioner and grand academician of the Jixian Hall; Wang Yiyong military affairs commissioner; Song Qi participating administrator; Wu Yu and Pang Ji both vice military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Du Yan fell; Jia Changchao became co-chancellor and military commissioner; Wang Yiyong took the Military Commission; Song Qi joined the council; Wu Yu and Pang Ji became vice commissioners.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，詔罷京朝官用保任敘遷法，又罷蔭補限年法。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao, edict: capital officials’ promotion by guarantor was abolished, and limits on years for yin privilege appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinmao: capital promotion by guarantor and yin year-limits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，曩霄初遣人來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Nangxiao for the first time sent men to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Nangxiao sent his first New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以久旱，詔州縣毋得淹系刑獄。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: because of long drought, prefectures and counties were not to detain prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, long drought forbade counties to hold prisoners without cause.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祈雨于相國天清寺、會靈祥源觀。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: rain was prayed for at Xiangguo Tianqing Monastery and Huiling Xiangyuan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, rain was sought at Xiangguo Tianqing and Huiling Xiangyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，桂陽監言唐和等復內寇。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Guiyang surveillance reported Tang He and others again raiding within.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Guiyang reported Tang He and others raiding again.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，謝雨。

translations.literal: Day yimao: thanks were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the court thanked Heaven for rain.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，詔大宗正勵諸宗子授經務學。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei, edict: the Great Clan Director was to urge imperial clansmen to study the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei: the clan director was told to drive kinsmen to classical study.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，韓琦罷。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Han Qi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Han Qi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Day guihai, edict: the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宜州蠻賊區希范平。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Yizhou barbarian bandit Qu Xifan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Qu Xifan of Yizhou was crushed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，東方有黃氣如虹貫月。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: in the east yellow vapor like a rainbow crossed the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, yellow mist like a rainbow crossed the moon in the east.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔監司按察屬吏，毋得差官體量。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: surveillance commissioners inspecting subordinates might not send separate officials to measure them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, inspectors could not dispatch extra officers to vet subordinates.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔陝西以曩霄稱臣，降系囚罪一等，笞釋之，邊兵第賜緡錢。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: because Nangxiao styled himself subject, Shaanxi prisoners had crimes reduced one degree and flogging released; frontier soldiers received graded cash gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, with Nangxiao’s submission Shaanxi cut sentences one grade, freed flogging cases, and paid frontier troops in graded cash.

sentences.zh: 民去年逋負皆勿責，蠲其租稅之半，麟、府州嘗為羌所掠，除逋負租稅如之。

translations.literal: Last year’s arrears were not collected; half their taxes and levies were remitted; for Lin and Fu prefectures once plundered by Qiang, arrears and taxes were likewise remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Last year’s arrears were forgiven, taxes halved—and Lin and Fu, once ravaged by Qiang, got the same relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，罷入粟補官。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: office by grain contribution was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, buying office with grain was ended.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥朔，司天言日當食，陰晦不見。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dinghai new moon: the Directorate of Astronomy said the sun should be eclipsed; clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon dinghai: astronomers predicted an eclipse; clouds hid it.

sentences.zh: 錄系囚，遣官錄三京囚。

translations.literal: Prisoners were reviewed; officials were sent to review prisoners of the three capitals.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners were reviewed—and commissioners sent to the three capitals’ jails.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，曩霄初遣人來賀乾元節。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Nangxiao for the first time sent men to congratulate the Qianyuan festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Nangxiao sent his first envoys for the Qianyuan festival.

sentences.zh: 戊申，章得象罷，以賈昌朝為昭文館大學士，陳執中同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhang Dexiang was removed; Jia Changchao was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Chen Zhizhong co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, grand academician of the Jixian Hall, and military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Dexiang fell; Jia Changchao took Zhaowen; Chen Zhizhong became co-chancellor, Jixian academician, and military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以吳育參知政事，丁度為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wu Yu was made participating administrator; Ding Du vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wu Yu joined the council and Ding Du the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，罷諸路轉運判官。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: circuit transport vice commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jisi: circuit transport vice commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，曩霄遣人來謝冊命。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingwu: Nangxiao sent men to thank for the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingwu: Nangxiao’s envoys thanked the court for kingship.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，減益、梓州上供絹歲三之一，紅錦、鹿胎半之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: Yi and Zi prefectures’ annual tribute silk was cut by one-third; crimson brocade and deer-fetus by half.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingmao: Yi and Zi silk tribute fell by a third; crimson brocade and deer-fetus brocade by half.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，以廣州地震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: Guangzhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: Guangzhou was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，荊南府、岳州地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: Jingnan prefecture and Yue prefecture suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengwu: Jingnan and Yue prefectures quaked.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，詔文武官己致仕而舉官犯罪當連坐者，除之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin, edict: civil and military officials already retired who had recommended subordinates guilty of collective punishment were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: retired officials were cleared of collective guilt for crimes of men they had recommended.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以重陽，曲宴近臣、宗室于太清樓，遂射苑中。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: on the Double Ninth, a private feast for close officials and imperial clansmen at Taiqing Tower, then archery in the park.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Double Ninth: a private feast for intimates and kin at Taiqing Tower, then archery in the park.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，契丹遣使來獻九龍車及所獲夏國羊馬。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao: Khitan sent envoys presenting the Nine-Dragon carriage and Xia sheep and horses captured.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yimao: Khitan sent the Nine-Dragon carriage and Xia livestock taken in war.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祔章獻明肅皇后、章懿皇后神主于太廟，大赦。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the spirit tablets of Empresses Bright Offering Bright Solemn and Bright Grace were placed in the imperial temple; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Bright Offering Bright Solemn and Bright Grace entered the imperial temple—and great amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 罷轉運使兼按察。

translations.literal: Transport commissioners’ concurrent surveillance duty was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioners no longer doubled as inspectors.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸瓊林苑，遂畋楊村，遣使以所獲馳薦太廟，召父老，賜以飲食、茶帛。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the emperor visited Qionlin Garden, then hunted at Yang village; envoys presented quarry to the imperial temple; elders were summoned and given drink, food, tea, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, he hunted at Yang village after Qionlin Garden, sent game to the temple, and feasted local elders with food, tea, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 辛未，頒曆于夏國。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the calendar was issued to the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the calendar was sent to Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷宰臣兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: chief ministers’ concurrent military affairs posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, chief ministers ceased holding the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，冬至，宴宗室於崇政殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: winter solstice; imperial clansmen were feasted at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dinghai, winter solstice: kin were feasted at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔河北長吏舉殿直、供奉官有武才者。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: Hebei senior officials were to recommend palace guards and tribute officials with martial talent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Hebei chiefs were to nominate guards and tribute officers with martial talent.

sentences.zh: 是歲，施州溪洞蠻、西南夷龍以特來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Shizhou stream-cave barbarians and southwestern Yi Long Yite came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Shizhou cave tribes and the southwestern Yi Long Yite brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊申，徙廣南戍兵善地，以避瘴毒。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day wushen: Guangnan garrison troops were moved to healthier ground to avoid miasma.
translations.idiomatic: Year six, first month, wushen: Guangnan garrisons were shifted to healthier posts.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，青州地震。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: Qing prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuyin: Qingzhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西經略安撫及轉運司議裁節諸費及所置官員無用者以聞。

translations.literal: Edict: Shaanxi frontier pacification and transport offices were to discuss cutting expenses and useless officials and report.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi pacification and transport were told to propose cuts in spending and useless posts.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon xinsi: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 錄系囚。

translations.literal: Prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: The jails were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，登州地震，岠嵎山摧，自是屢震，輒海底有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Deng prefecture suffered an earthquake; Juxie mountain collapsed; thereafter quakes came repeatedly, each time with thunder from the sea floor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Dengzhou shook and Juxie mountain fell; quakes followed, each with thunder from beneath the sea.

sentences.zh: 甲午，月犯歲星。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the moon violated Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the moon crossed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身八百五十三人。

translations.literal: That month, eight hundred fifty-three men passed the Ministry of Rites examination as presented scholars and specialist graduates.
translations.idiomatic: That month, eight hundred fifty-three passed the Ministry of Rites examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，遣使賜湖南戍兵方藥。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: envoys were sent to give Hunan garrison troops medicinal formulas.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiayin: envoys brought medicine to Hunan garrisons.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，京師雨雹，地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: the capital rained hail and suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiashen: hail and earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，減邛州鹽井歲課緡錢一百萬。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Qiong prefecture salt wells’ annual levy was cut by a million strings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Qiong salt-well levies fell by a million strings.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔陝西市蕃部馬。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: tribal horses of the western market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the western market was opened to tribal horses.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，京東人劉巹、劉沔、胡信謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Jingdong men Liu Song, Liu Mian, and Hu Xin plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Liu Song, Liu Mian, and Hu Xin of Jingdong plotted revolt and were executed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，詔夏竦與河北監司察帥臣、長吏之不職者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu new moon, edict: Xia Song with Hebei surveillance commissioners was to investigate commanders and senior officials who failed duty.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon gengxu: Xia Song and Hebei inspectors were to expose derelict commanders and chiefs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，有流星出營室南，其光燭地，隱然有聲。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: a meteor appeared south of Encampment; its light lit the ground and it faded with a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, a meteor blazed south of Encampment, lit the earth, and died with a sound.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以久旱，民多暍死，命京城增鑿井三百九十。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: because of long drought many died of heat; the capital was ordered to sink three hundred ninety more wells.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, drought heat killed many; the capital was told to dig three hundred ninety more wells.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔制科隨禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: special examination graduates were to follow the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, special-examination graduates were folded into the regular Ministry of Rites exam.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: the moon violated the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dinghai: the moon crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，河東經略司言雨壞忻、代等州城壁。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Hedong frontier office reported rain had ruined walls at Xin, Dai, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hedong reported rain had wrecked walls at Xin, Dai, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，策試賢良方正能直言極諫，並試武舉人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: worthy and upright who speak bluntly were examined, and military examination candidates tested.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guihai: worthy-and-upright and military candidates were examined.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以吳育為樞密副使，丁度參知政事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Wu Yu was made vice military affairs commissioner; Ding Du participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wu Yu took the Military Commission and Ding Du joined the council.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，登州言有巨木三千餘浮海而出。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: Deng prefecture reported more than three thousand great timbers floating out of the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiachen: Dengzhou reported three thousand great logs washed from the sea.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，詔發兵討湖南徭賊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei, edict: troops were sent to attack Hunan Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinwei: troops marched against Hunan Yao bandits.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，遣官議夏國公封界。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: officials were sent to discuss the Xia king’s border.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jimao: commissioners were sent to fix the Xia king’s borders.

sentences.zh: 癸未，湖南徭賊寇英、韶州界。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Hunan Yao bandits raided the borders of Ying and Shao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Hunan Yao raiders struck Ying and Shao.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，畋東韓村，乘輿所過及圍內田，蠲其租一年。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: hunting at East Han village; fields the imperial carriage passed and those within the hunt enclosure had rent remitted one year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, hunting at East Han village—fields the carriage crossed and those inside the beat were tax-free for a year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，邈川首領唃廝囉、西蕃瞎氈、磨氈角、安化州蠻蒙光速等來貢。

translations.literal: That year, the leader of distant Chuan Gusiluo, western tribesmen Zhazhan, Mozhanjiao, Anhua tribesman Meng Guangsu, and others came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Gusiluo of distant Chuan, Zhazhan, Mozhanjiao, Meng Guangsu of Anhua, and others brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 交阯獻馴象十。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi presented ten tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi sent ten trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 道州部瀧酋李石壁等降。

translations.literal: Buluo chief Li Shibi of Daozhou and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shibi of Daozhou’s Buluo tribe and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丙子朔，禦大慶殿受朝。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, new moon bingzi: the emperor held court reception at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 7, first month, new moon bingzi: the court received New Year homage at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔河北所括馬死者，限二年償之。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: for horses requisitioned in Hebei that died, repayment was limited to two years.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hebei was told to repay requisitioned horses that died within two years.

sentences.zh: 己亥，頒《慶曆編敕》。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Qingli Compiled Statutes were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Qingli Compiled Statutes were issued.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔減連州民被徭害者來年夏租。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: reduce next year’s summer tax for Lian prefecture people harmed by corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Lian corvée victims received a cut in next summer’s tax.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，詔取益州交子三十萬，于秦州募人入中糧。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou, edict: take three hundred thousand strings of Yizhou jiaozi notes and use them at Qinzhou to recruit men for advance grain delivery.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiyou: three hundred thousand strings of Yizhou jiaozi were to buy Qinzhou grain through advance contractors.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，令內侍二人提舉月給軍糧。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: two palace eunuchs were ordered to supervise monthly military grain payments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, two inner eunuchs took charge of monthly army rations.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renwu: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔天下有能言寬恤民力之事者，有司驛置以聞，以其副上之轉運司，詳其可行者輒行之。

translations.literal: Day guiwei, edict: anyone nationwide who could propose measures to ease popular burdens was to be relayed by fast post; a copy went to the transport commissioner, who was to execute what proved feasible.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, popular-relief proposals were rushed to court and copied to transport commissioners for immediate trial where feasible.

sentences.zh: 毀後苑龍船。

translations.literal: Dragon boats in the rear garden were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The rear-garden dragon boats were scrapped.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以旱，罷大宴。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because of drought, the grand feast was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, drought cancelled the grand feast.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔避正殿，減常膳。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: avoid the main hall and reduce regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the court left the main hall and cut the regular table.

sentences.zh: 許中外臣僚實封條上三事。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside were permitted to submit sealed memorials on three matters.
translations.idiomatic: Officials everywhere could seal three-item memorials to the throne.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賈昌朝罷，以陳執中為昭文館大學士，夏竦同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，吳育為給事中歸班，文彥博為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Jia Changchao was removed; Chen Zhizhong was made Zhaowen grand academician; Xia Song associate chief councilor and Jixian grand academician; Wu Yu was made supervising attendant and returned to court rank; Wen Yanbo was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Jia Changchao fell; Chen Zhizhong took Zhaowen; Xia Song joined the council; Wu Yu returned as supervising attendant; Wen Yanbo became deputy military director.

sentences.zh: 罷出獵。

translations.literal: Hunting excursions were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial hunts were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以夏竦為樞密使，文彥博參知政事，高若訥為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Xia Song was made military affairs commissioner; Wen Yanbo participating administrator; Gao Ruonu vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Xia Song headed Military Affairs; Wen Yanbo joined the council; Gao Ruonu became his deputy.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祈雨於西太一宮，及還，遂雨。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: rain was prayed for at the Western Supreme Unity palace; on return it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, rain rites at Western Supreme Unity brought rain on the way back.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陳執中、宋庠、丁度以旱，降官一等。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Chen Zhizhong, Song Qi, and Ding Du were reduced one rank for drought.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Chen Zhizhong, Song Qi, and Ding Du lost one rank over the drought.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，謝雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei: thanksgiving for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingwei: the court gave thanks for rain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔：「前京東轉運使薛紳專任文吏伺察郡縣細過，江東轉運使楊弦、判官王綽、提點刑獄王鼎苛刻相尚，並削職知州，自今毋復用為部使者。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: “Former Jingdong transport commissioner Xue Shen relied solely on clerks to spy on prefectures’ and counties’ petty faults; Jiangdong transport commissioner Yang Xian, judicial assistant Wang Chuo, and punishments intendant Wang Ding vied in harshness—all were stripped of office and made prefects; from now on do not again appoint them as circuit commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Xue Shen, Yang Xian, Wang Chuo, and Wang Ding were demoted to prefect for petty surveillance and mutual harshness—and barred from circuit posts thereafter.

sentences.zh: 」壬子，禦正殿，復常膳。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the emperor held court in the main hall and regular meals were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the court returned to the main hall and normal meals.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復執中、庠、度官。

translations.literal: Day maoyin: the ranks of Zhizhong, Qi, and Du were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On maoyin, Chen Zhizhong, Song Qi, and Ding Du regained their ranks.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔諫官非公事毋得私謁。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: remonstrance officials might not pay private visits except on public business.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, remonstrators were forbidden private calls except on duty.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，詔武臣非曆知州、軍無過者，毋授同提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin, edict: military officials who had not served as prefect or army commander without fault were not to be appointed concurrent punishments intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuyin: military men without a clean prefectural or garrison term could not double as punishments intendant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，補降徭唐和等為峒主。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Tang He and other surrendered Yao were appointed dong chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Tang He and fellow surrendered Yao became dong chiefs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命翰林學士楊察蠲放天下逋負。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hanlin academician Yang Cha was ordered to remit all outstanding debts nationwide.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yang Cha was to cancel nationwide tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔西北二邊有大事，二府與兩制以上雜議之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: on great matters on the two northwest frontiers, the Two Departments and drafting officials and above were to discuss together.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, major northwest crises required joint counsel of the Two Departments and drafting officials.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，詔禁畜猛獸害人者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi, edict: keeping fierce beasts that harmed people was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yisi: private keeping of man-killing beasts was banned.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔天下知縣非鞫獄毋得差遣。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: magistrates nationwide might not send people on missions except for trials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, county magistrates could dispatch men only for judicial work.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔臣僚朝見者，留京毋過十日。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: officials attending court audience might not remain in the capital more than ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, visiting officials had ten days in the capital at most.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，奉安太祖、太宗、真宗御容于南京鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong were installed at Hongqing palace in the Southern Capital.
