translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiwei: Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong portraits were enshrined at Southern Capital Hongqing palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，德音：降南京畿內囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, gracious edict: crimes of prisoners in the Southern Capital capital region were reduced one degree; penal servants and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Southern Capital prisoners were cut one grade; penal servants and below went free.

sentences.zh: 賜民夏稅之半。

translations.literal: Half the summer tax was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Half the summer tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 除災傷倚閣稅及欠折官物非侵盜者。

translations.literal: Disaster-deferred taxes and shortfalls of official property not from embezzlement were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster deferrals and honest shortfalls on state goods were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，禁貢餘物饋近臣。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: presenting surplus goods to close ministers was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, surplus gifts to intimate ministers were banned.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，析河北為四路，各置都總管。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: Hebei was divided into four circuits, each with a grand army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yichou: Hebei split into four circuits, each with a grand commander.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，詔刪定《一州一縣敕》。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou, edict: revise the One-Prefecture-One-County Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingyou: the One-Prefecture-One-County Statutes were ordered revised.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，李迪薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renzi: Li Di died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renzi: Li Di died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸廣親宅，謁太祖、太宗神禦殿，宴宗室，賜器幣有差。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the emperor visited Guangqin mansion, paid respects at the spirit halls of Taizu and Taizong, banqueted the imperial clan, and granted vessels and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, he visited Guangqin, saluted Taizu and Taizong, feasted kin, and gave graded vessels and silk.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河陽、許州地震。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Heyang and Xu prefectures reported earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Heyang and Xu reported earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，加上真宗諡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: Zhenzong’s posthumous title was augmented.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiwei: Zhenzong’s posthumous style was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 丙申，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: morning feast at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the court feasted at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，饗太廟、奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the imperial temple and Fengci temple were feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, offerings went to the imperial and Fengci temples.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，冬至，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, winter solstice: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, winter solstice: round-altar rites and a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 貝州宣毅卒王則據城反。

translations.literal: Xuan Yi troops of Beizhou—soldier Wang Ze—seized the city and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Beizhou Xuan Yi soldier Wang Ze seized the city and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: additional favor to officials.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen: officials received extra favors.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，樞密直學士明鎬體量安撫河北。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: direct academician of Military Affairs Ming Hao was sent to assess and comfort Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Ming Hao went to assess and comfort Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔貝州有能引致官兵獲賊者，授諸衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: whoever at Beizhou could lure government troops and capture the rebels would receive the rank of general of the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, anyone who drew troops to capture the Bei rebels would be made a guards general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣內侍以敕榜招安貝賊。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: palace eunuchs were sent with imperial placards to win over the Bei rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, eunuchs carried placards to win over Wang Ze’s men.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西蕃磨氈角來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Mo’angjiao of the Western Tibetans came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Mo’angjiao of western Tibet sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丁丑，文彥博宣撫河北，明鎬副之。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, first month, day dingchou: Wen Yanbo was pacification commissioner for Hebei; Ming Hao was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Year eight, first month, dingchou: Wen Yanbo pacified Hebei with Ming Hao as deputy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，江寧府火。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Jiangning prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Jiangning burned.

sentences.zh: 乙未，日赤無光。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the sun was red and without light.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the sun turned dull red and dim.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，貝州平。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinchou: Beizhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, xinchou: Beizhou fell.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曲赦河北，賜平貝州將士緡錢，戰沒者官為葬祭，兵所踐民田蠲其稅，改貝州為恩州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: partial amnesty for Hebei; cash was granted to troops who pacified Beizhou; the state buried and sacrificed those killed in battle; tax on fields trampled by troops was remitted; Beizhou was changed to En prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Hebei received partial amnesty, rewards for the Bei pacifiers, state burial for the dead, remission of trampled fields, and Beizhou was renamed En.

sentences.zh: 戊申，文彥博同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，官吏將士有功者遷擢有差。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wen Yanbo was made associate chief councilor and Jixian grand academician; officials, clerks, and troops with merit were promoted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wen Yanbo joined the council; meritorious officers and soldiers were promoted by grade.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，親從官顏秀等四人夜入禁中謀為變，宿衛兵捕殺之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: four close attendants—Yan Xiu and others—entered the forbidden quarter at night plotting mutiny; night-guard soldiers captured and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, four close attendants led by Yan Xiu broke in by night to mutiny; the night guard killed them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，磔王則於都市。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Wang Ze was dismembered in the capital market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wang Ze was dismembered in the capital market.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，知貝州張得一坐降賊伏誅。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Beizhou prefect Zhang Deyi was executed for surrendering to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhang Deyi was executed for yielding Beizhou to Wang Ze.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，頒《慶曆善救方》。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: the Qingli Good Rescue Formulas were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guiyou: the Qingli Good Rescue Formulas were issued.

sentences.zh: 夏國來告曩霄卒。

translations.literal: The Xia state came to report Nangxia’s death.
translations.idiomatic: Xia envoys announced Nangxia’s death.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜瀛、莫、恩、冀州緡錢二萬，贖還饑民鬻子。

translations.literal: Day jimao: twenty thousand strings of cash were granted to Ying, Mo, En, and Ji prefectures to ransom children hunger-sold by the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Ying, Mo, En, and Ji each received twenty thousand strings to buy back children sold in famine.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，奉安宣祖、太祖、太宗御容於睦親宅。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: imperial portraits of the Xuangu ancestor, Taizu, and Taizong were installed at Muqin mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Xuangu, Taizu, and Taizong portraits were enshrined at Muqin mansion.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen, edict: Ministry of Rites examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiachen: the Ministry of Rites examinations were ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣使體量安撫陝西。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: envoys were sent to assess and comfort Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, envoys went to assess and comfort Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸龍圖、天章閣，詔輔臣曰：「西陲備禦，兵冗賞濫，罔知所從，卿等各以所見條奏。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the emperor visited the Longtu and Tianzhang pavilions and ordered the chief ministers: “Western frontier defense—troops redundant, rewards excessive; we do not know what to follow; each of you submit your views in memorials.”
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, at Longtu and Tianzhang he told his chancellors to memorialize how to cut redundant frontier troops and lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 」又詔翰林學士、三司使、知開封府、御史中丞曰：「朕躬闕失，左右朋邪，中外險詐，州郡暴虐，法令有不便於民者，朕欲聞之，其悉以陳。

translations.literal: He also ordered Hanlin academicians, the Three Departments commissioner, the Kaifeng prefect, and the censor-in-chief: “Our personal omissions, flatterers left and right, deception inside and out, prefectural cruelty, laws inconvenient to the people—we wish to hear; report all fully.”
translations.idiomatic: He likewise summoned drafting officials, the finance chief, Kaifeng, and the censor to expose court faults, flattery, fraud, cruelty, and bad laws.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，以霖雨，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day renxu: because of prolonged rain, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, prolonged rain brought a prisoner review.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以朝政得失、兵農要務、邊防備豫、將帥能否、財賦利害、錢法是非與夫讒人害政、奸盜亂俗及防微杜漸之策，召知制誥、諫官、御史等諭之，使悉對於篇。

translations.literal: Day guihai: on court policy gains and losses, military and agricultural essentials, frontier preparedness, generals’ competence, fiscal profit and harm, currency right and wrong, slanderers harming government, traitors and robbers disturbing customs, and measures to guard the subtle and stop the gradual—drafting officials, remonstrators, and censors were summoned and instructed to respond fully in writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, drafters, remonstrators, and censors were told to write fully on policy, war, frontier commanders, finance, coinage, slander, disorder, and preventive governance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳朔，封曩霄子諒祚為夏國主。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jisi new moon: Nangxia’s son Liangzuo was enfeoffed as Xia ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon jisi: Nangxia’s son Liangzuo was enfeoffed as Xia king.

sentences.zh: 壬申，丁度罷，明鎬參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Ding Du was removed; Ming Hao was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Ding Du fell and Ming Hao joined the council.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，夏竦罷，宋庠為樞密使，龐籍參知政事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: Xia Song was removed; Song Qi was made military affairs commissioner; Pang Ji was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou: Xia Song was dismissed; Song Qi took Military Affairs; Pang Ji joined the council.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，詔近臣舉文武官材堪將帥者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen new moon, edict: close ministers were to recommend civil and military officials talented for command.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon wuchen: intimate ministers were to nominate civil and military men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河決澶州商胡埽。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Yellow River burst at the Shanghu embankment in Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Yellow River broke through Shanghu embankment in Cao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以久雨齋禱。

translations.literal: Day renchen: because of prolonged rain, fasting and prayer were held.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, prolonged rain brought fasting and prayer.

sentences.zh: 甲午，明鎬卒。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Ming Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Ming Hao died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔館閣官須親民一任，方許入省、府及轉運、提點刑獄差遣。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: Archive officials must serve one popular post before appointment to ministries, offices, transport, or punishments intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, archive officers needed a county term before ministry, transport, or judicial posts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，章得象薨。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Zhang Dexiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhang Dexiang died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以河北水，令州縣募饑民為軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuxu: because of Hebei flooding, prefectures and counties were ordered to recruit hungry people as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuxu: Hebei floods sent prefectures recruiting the hungry into the army.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: casting iron currency was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, iron coin casting was halted.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以河北、京東西水災，罷秋宴。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: because of flooding in Hebei and eastern and western Jingdong, the autumn feast was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jichou: Hebei and Jingdong floods cancelled the autumn feast.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，詔三司以今年江、淮漕米轉給河北州軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu, edict: the Three Departments were to use this year’s Jiang-Huai transport grain to supply Hebei prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: the Three Departments were to feed Hebei from this year’s Jiang-Huai grain.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己亥，作「皇帝欽崇國祀之寶」。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jihai: the seal “Emperor Reverently Honors State Sacrifice Treasure” was made.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai: the seal “Emperor Reverently Honors State Sacrifice” was cast.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，出廩米，減價以濟畿內貧民。

translations.literal: Day renxu: granary grain was issued and the price reduced to aid poor people in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, capital granaries sold grain cheap to the poor.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，以霖雨為災，頒德音，改明年元，減天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou new moon: because prolonged rain was a disaster, a gracious edict was issued, next year’s era name was changed, crimes of prisoners nationwide were reduced one degree, and penal servants and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon yichou: endless rain brought a gracious edict, a new era, one-grade cuts for prisoners, and freedom for penal servants and below.

sentences.zh: 出內藏錢帛賜三司，貿粟以濟河北，流民所過，官為舍止之，所齎物毋收算。

translations.literal: Inner-treasury cash and silks were issued to the Three Departments to buy grain for Hebei relief; wherever refugees passed, the government provided lodging; goods they carried were not taxed.
translations.idiomatic: Inner funds bought Hebei grain; refugees were lodged free on the road and their baggage went untaxed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，冊美人張氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Lady Zhang of the Beauties was ennobled as Precious Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Lady Zhang became Precious Consort.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣使體量安撫利州路。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: envoys were sent to assess and comfort Lizhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, envoys went to assess and comfort Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，廬州合肥縣稻再實。

translations.literal: That year, rice in Hefei county, Luzhou double-fruited.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hefei rice bore two crops.

sentences.zh: 交州來貢。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhou sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Huangyou year one, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyou 1, first month, new moon jiaxu: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 以河北水災，罷上元張燈，停作樂。

translations.literal: Because of the Hebei flood disaster, Lantern Festival lamps were cancelled and music performances stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei floods cancelled Lantern lamps and court music.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張士遜薨。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Shixun died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Shixun died.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔以緡錢二十萬市穀種，分給河北貧民。

translations.literal: Day jiwei, edict: two hundred thousand strings of cash were used to buy grain seed and distributed to Hebei poor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, two hundred thousand strings bought seed for Hebei’s poor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔台諫非朝廷得失、民間利病，毋風聞彈奏。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: censors and remonstrators might not memorialize on rumor unless the matter concerned court gains and losses or popular benefit and harm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, censors and remonstrators could report only court policy or public welfare—not rumor.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，以河北疫，遣使頒藥。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: because of epidemic in Hebei, envoys were sent to distribute medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuchen: Hebei’s epidemic brought medicine envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛未，發禁軍十指揮赴京東、西路備盜。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: ten commands of the forbidden army were sent to eastern and western Jingdong circuits against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, ten forbidden-army commands went to Jingdong and Jingxi against bandits.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己未，契丹遣使來告伐夏國。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Khitan sent envoys announcing an attack on the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Liao envoys announced war on Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚申，翰林院學士錢明逸報使契丹。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Hanlin academy academician Qian Mingyi returned as envoy from the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Qian Mingyi returned from the Liao mission.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身千三百九人。

translations.literal: That month, one thousand three hundred nine jinshi and miscellaneous subjects who passed the Ministry of Rites list were granted rank.
translations.idiomatic: That month 1,309 jinshi and other graduates on the Ministry of Rites list received rank.

sentences.zh: 四月癸未，梓州轉運司言淯井監夷人平。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guiwei: Zizhou transport office reported that the Yi of Yujing supervision were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiwei: Zizhou reported the Yujing Yi pacified.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，蠲河北復業民租賦二年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: two years of rent and tax were remitted for Hebei people resuming cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiazi: Hebei resettlers got two years’ tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，始置觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Guanwen Hall grand academician was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Guanwen Hall grand academician was created.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔中書、樞密非聚議毋通賓客。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: the Secretariat and Military Affairs might not entertain guests except in joint consultation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Secretariat and Military Affairs could receive guests only in joint session.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔轉運使、提點刑獄，所部官吏受贓失覺察者，降黜。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: transport commissioners and punishments intendants whose subordinate officials took bribes without their detection were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, transport and judicial commissioners were demoted if subordinates bribed undetected.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，詔臣僚毋得保薦要近內臣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingyou, edict: officials might not recommend close inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingyou: recommending intimate inner eunuchs was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔諸州歲市藥以療民疾。

translations.literal: Day jiwei, edict: all prefectures were annually to purchase medicines to treat people’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, every prefecture was to buy medicine yearly for the sick.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，陳執中罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu: Chen Zhizhong was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renxu: Chen Zhizhong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以文彥博為昭文館大學士，宋庠同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，龐籍為樞密使，高若訥參知政事，梁適為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo was made Zhaowen grand academician; Song Qi associate chief councilor and Jixian grand academician; Pang Ji military affairs commissioner; Gao Ruonu participating administrator; Liang Shi vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo took Zhaowen; Song Qi joined the council; Pang Ji headed Military Affairs; Gao Ruonu and Liang Shi became his deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲申，策制舉、武舉人。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: policy examination for classical recruitment and military examinees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, special-recruitment and military candidates faced the policy exam.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，廣源州蠻儂智高寇邕州，詔江南、福建等路發兵以備。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yisi: Guangyuan prefecture barbarian Nong Zhigao raided Yong prefecture; Jiangnan, Fujian, and other circuits were ordered to mobilize troops in preparation.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi: Nong Zhigao of Guangyuan raided Yong; Jiangnan, Fujian, and other circuits mobilized.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷武舉。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the military examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the military examination ended.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙申，詔河北被災民八十以上及篤疾不能自存者，人賜米一石、酒一斗。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day bingshen, edict: Hebei disaster victims eighty and above and gravely ill people unable to support themselves—each was granted one shi of rice and one dou of wine.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingshen: Hebei victims eighty or older or gravely ill and destitute received one shi of rice and one dou of wine each.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔民有冤、貧不能詣闕者，聽訴于監司以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: people with grievances too poor to come to court might appeal to surveillance commissioners to report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the poor with grievances could petition surveillance commissioners instead of coming to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，遣入內供奉高懷政督捕邕州盜賊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: inner-service attendant Gao Huaizheng was sent to supervise capture of Yong prefecture bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiazi: Gao Huaizheng was sent to hunt Yong bandits.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大留國來貢。

translations.literal: That year, the Greater Liu state came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Greater Liu sent tribute.
